projects.title: Cube
projects.description: A handheld device comprising six OLED screens, one for each face of a cube. This project required the design of circuits for battery management and voltage regulation, 3D modelling of the frame, and efficient C code to run six screens and a six-DOF sensor from a single ESP32.

projects.title: Orthodox
projects.description: A unique ortholinear keyboard. This project required rapid prototyping of custom keycaps using parametric designs, PCB coils around key switches to measure analogue key presses with an LDC chip, and a custom driver to allow seamless integration with computers.

experience.title: Support Host
bullets: Managed passenger boarding, ticket checks and payments, while responding to service issues and complaints with professionalism and tact.
Developed strong interpersonal and conflict-resolution skills when dealing with difficult customers, resolving concerns and communicating service disruptions and alternative travel arrangements.

Coordinated time-critical morning operations, ensuring passengers were awake, prepared and ready to disembark on schedule, while liaising with station staff to arrange breakfast orders and food deliveries.

Responded to safety and security incidents, including medical emergencies, fire procedures and unauthorised attempts to board the train, following established procedures and contacting emergency services when required.

Maintained clear communication with the Train Manager and passengers during significant journey disruptions, helping coordinate practical solutions in challenging situations, including remote areas of Scotland.

experience.title: RF Test Engineer
bullets: Used LaTeX to produce clean, well-formatted reports from data and graphs generated with Matplotlib.
Collaborated on and documented repositories using GitLab, Jira, Confluence, and Slack.
Developed Python libraries to control rotators, switches, Keysight VNAs, and beamforming ICs, automating radiation pattern measurements in a custom anechoic chamber.
Translated MATLAB algorithms for phase tapering and beam steering of a phased array antenna into working code on early prototype hardware.

experience.title: Research & Development Engineer
bullets: Analysed device reliability using PAM4/NRZ inspection, shear testing, and electroluminescence inspection.
Built a standalone program with PyQt to automatically produce failure analysis reports from data gathered by lab technicians, saving countless engineering hours on a repetitive manual task.
Developed a Python library to communicate with a TEC controller over a serial protocol.
Led weekly meetings to update senior engineers on device failures and reliability.

experience.title: Hardware Engineer
bullets: Designed and soldered the power management PCB for an underwater ROV.
Met with suppliers to discuss partnerships and sponsorships for the competition.
Regularly liaised with engineers from different disciplines to check compatibility.
Managed my time effectively to balance university commitments with those to Avalon.

volunteering.title: Trail Maintenance & Stonework
bullets: Built traditional loose stone walls and helped create new flat land on the hilly terrain in Lavizzara, designed to support vehicle access for the local area.
Travelled by helicopter to work at altitude and cleared overgrown trails with a team using strimmers.

volunteering.title: Restoration Volunteer
bullets: Carried out renovation work on a Cold War-era nuclear bunker, including cleaning, wall preparation, plastering, wall cladding, and installing electrical conduit.

volunteering.title: Land & Animal Care
bullets: Maintained rural land, carried out household repairs, and managed the welfare of dogs and livestock.
Learned Buddhist philosophy, meditation, and breathing techniques from an elderly Buddhist practitioner.

volunteering.title: Temple Maintenance & Community Volunteering
bullets: Maintained temple grounds and Zen gardens through weeding, watering, and gravel raking, helping preserve the temple's environment.
Took part in daily 5:00 am Zen meditation and morning temple rituals, including ringing the temple bell.
Assisted with preparations for the Tanabata Star Festival, supporting the organisation of a traditional Japanese cultural event.
